in_sanskrit.name: Harvani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fertile, Abundant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Harvani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Harvani is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'har' meaning 'abundance' and 'vani' meaning 'voice'. This name signifies a fertile and abundant being, often associated with the voice of nature and the rains that bring life to the land.
